title: Code and results: Deep sequence learning and gradient boosting for forecasting soil organic carbon change in Europe

creators.name: Hasan, Md Rakib
creators.affiliation: Department of Soil, Water and Environment, University of Dhaka; Fermium Systems

description: Analysis code, result tables, figures and run logs for a test of a convolutional-recurrent hybrid against gradient boosting for forecasting change in soil organic carbon on LUCAS topsoil points sampled in 2009, 2015 and 2018, under spatially blocked validation with hyperparameters selected inside each training fold. Version 3.0.0 corrects a data error present in every earlier version: the loader read electrical conductivity as organic carbon for the 2015 and 2018 campaigns, so all results in versions 2.0.0 to 2.2.2 are invalid and should not be used or cited. The loader now selects only organic-carbon columns, with a guard and a self-test, and every result is regenerated. Version 3.0.0 also adds an analysis of signal and noise in repeated measurements: the share of measured change that is measurement error, the dependence of change on the starting level with the earliest survey as an instrument, the ceiling on skill by stratum, and pH and total nitrogen as controls. The LUCAS source data and the panel derived from them are not redistributed, since their licence does not permit it; the code rebuilds the panel from files obtained directly from the European Soil Data Centre. Version 3.1.0 adds analyses requested in a pre-submission review: the comparison with ERA5-Land climate and the forward-in-time design at new places, each pooled over five replicates of the fold assignment; a repeat of the central comparison with 56 blocks of 390 km; and the mean previous organic carbon and static properties of each point's graph neighbours as features for the tabular models. The single-assignment climate result of version 3.0.0 does not survive pooling.
